_comment: Per-image provenance.json, written by jenkins/vars/writeProvenance.groovy AFTER every build (one per image, in the cell's workdir). This is the INPUT the internal CLI consumes to generate + attest the final SLSA predicate (secureImage). The digest is the staging manifest digest, which is byte-identical to the published digest (registry-side retag). Edit this file to evolve the contract; keep writeProvenance.groovy in sync.
